forecast.significanceNote: The significance score (0–100) is a relative rating the calculation provider assigns to rank events. It does not indicate the probability of the event, a definite outcome, a health risk or financial gain.
forecast.scopeNote: Scope: the transiting bodies in this calendar run from the Sun to Pluto; aspects of the transiting Moon to the natal chart and the Moon's sign ingresses are not included. Lunar phases and eclipses are included.
forecast.dayAria: Transit detail for the selected day
forecast.dayTitle: Transit Detail for the Selected Day · {date}
forecast.personalNone: No (major) transit aspect to the natal chart perfects on this day; all of the day's transit aspects appear in the day's transit chart.
forecast.skyNone: No general sky events on this day.
forecast.noonFromDesk: The day's transit chart is opened from the analysis workbench (no calculation is run in the saved-analysis view).
forecast.planChecking: Checking the plan (no request is sent to the provider)…
forecast.planCached: A saved result exists — no new request.
forecast.planNew: {n, plural, one {# new calculation request will be sent.} other {# new calculation requests will be sent.}}
forecast.dayFootnote: Calendar events are refined to the exact moment by the provider; applying/separating status and all aspects appear in the day's transit chart. The transit chart opens in a new analysis tab and can be saved separately; this calendar analysis does not change.
forecast.pickDayAria: Pick a day from the calendar
forecast.noMatch: No events match the selected filters.
